title: Cedarline Summit Equity Share Schedule for a First Extension in Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases
content:
**Equity share.** For the first extension on a Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases case on a Cedarline Summit Proprietary Reverse Mortgage loan whose borrower has died, the equity share is:

- the Summit loan balance, divided by the case's as-is appraised value, multiplied by 100;
- rounded half up to two decimal places;
- taken as 100 when the case has no appraisal recorded or no Summit loan balance is on file.

**Rule.**

- Where the equity share is no more than 50, 14 calendar days are added to the extension length.
- Where it is more than 50 and no more than 80, 7 calendar days are added to it.
- Where it is more than 80, nothing is added.

| Equity share | Days added to the extension length |
|---|---|
| up to and including 50.00 | 14 |
| 50.01 to 80.00 | 7 |
| above 80.00, or taken as 100 | 0 |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

- Balance 240,000.00 against an appraised value of 300,000.00 gives 80.00, which is no more than 80. 7 days are added.
- Balance 240,030.00 against 300,000.00 gives 80.01. Nothing is added.
- No appraisal on the case: the share is taken as 100, and nothing is added.
